spotlight.title: TRIVEA
spotlight.summary: TRIVEA combines learned ranking models with visual explanations of model fit and attribute influence, so people can explore how a black-box ranker behaves without direct access to the model.

title: TRIVEA: Transparent Ranking Interpretation using Visual Explanation of black-box Algorithmic rankers
